Title: Private Preview: Azure Site Recovery support for Azure Trusted Launch VMs (Windows OS)

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce the private preview of Azure Site Recovery support for Azure Trusted Launch VMs. Azure Trusted Launch VMs provide foundational compute security to Azure Generation 2 VMs by enabling Secure Boot and vTPM capabilities.  Please note that this private preview is for Windows OS only. 

You can request enrolment into private preview by filling the form.
